functions.name: sorbet_getVersion
functions.description: Returns the Sorbet version string for the current build. Intended for displaying or logging the tool/library version. The content and format are not specified here (e.g., may be a semantic version or similar).
requirements: No arguments required.
Return value is a pointer to a null-terminated string; the memory must not be modified or freed by the caller (const ownership).
No error reporting is defined; callers should not rely on a specific format or non-null guarantee unless documented elsewhere.
Link against the Sorbet library that defines this symbol.

functions.name: sorbet_getCodename
functions.description: Returns the Sorbet release codename string for the current build, if any. Useful for display or diagnostic purposes. The format/content are unspecified.
requirements: No arguments required.
Return value is a pointer to a null-terminated string; do not modify or free it (const ownership).
No explicit error contract is provided; do not assume non-null or a particular format.
Must be linked with the Sorbet library providing this symbol.

functions.name: sorbet_getBuildSCMRevision
functions.description: Returns the source control revision (e.g., git commit hash) used for this build of Sorbet. Typically used for precise build identification in logs and diagnostics. Exact VCS and hash format are not specified here.
requirements: No arguments required.
Returned pointer refers to an immutable, null-terminated string; do not modify or free it.
No error/NULL behavior is specified; callers should not assume non-null without external guarantees.
Requires linking against the Sorbet library that defines the symbol.

functions.name: sorbet_getBuildSCMCommitCount
functions.description: Returns an integer count of source control commits at the time of the build. Useful for build metadata or versioning schemes. The exact counting method is not specified.
requirements: No arguments required.
Return type is an int; range, sign, and semantics beyond being a count are not specified.
No error signaling is defined (e.g., negative for error is not specified).
Requires linking against the Sorbet library that defines the symbol.

functions.name: sorbet_getBuildSCMClean
functions.description: Returns a string indicating whether the source tree was clean at build time (e.g., clean/dirty). Exact values and format are not specified here.
requirements: No arguments required.
Returned value is a pointer to a null-terminated, immutable string; do not modify or free it.
No explicit error/NULL contract is provided; do not assume non-null or particular contents.
Link with the Sorbet library providing this symbol.

functions.name: sorbet_getBuildTimestamp
functions.description: Returns the build timestamp as a long. Intended for diagnostics or reproducibility metadata. The time unit/epoch (e.g., Unix seconds) is not specified in this header.
requirements: No arguments required.
Return type is long; interpretation (units, timezone, epoch) is unspecified—treat as opaque unless documented elsewhere.
No error signaling is defined.
Requires linking against the Sorbet library that defines the symbol.

functions.name: sorbet_getFullVersionString
functions.description: Returns a composite, human-readable version string that may include version, codename, SCM revision, and other metadata. Intended for display/logging. Exact format is unspecified.
requirements: No arguments required.
Return value is a pointer to a null-terminated, immutable string; do not modify or free it.
No explicit error/NULL contract is provided; callers should not assume non-null or a specific format.
Requires linking against the Sorbet library that defines the symbol.

functions.name: sorbet_getIsReleaseBuild
functions.description: Returns an integer flag indicating whether this is a release build. Intended as a boolean-like value (nonzero/zero), but exact semantics are not specified in this header.
requirements: No arguments required.
Return type is int; treat nonzero/zero as boolean only if documented elsewhere—semantics are not guaranteed here.
No error signaling is defined.
Requires linking against the Sorbet library that defines the symbol.

functions.name: sorbet_getIsWithDebugSymbols
functions.description: Returns an integer flag indicating whether the build includes debug symbols. Intended as a boolean-like indicator for diagnostics or feature gating; exact semantics are not specified here.
requirements: No arguments required.
Return type is int; interpretation as boolean (nonzero/zero) is conventional but not guaranteed by this header.
No error signaling is defined.
Requires linking against the Sorbet library that defines the symbol.
